{{for|the servant in the [[Royal Palace of Andor|Royal Palace]] of [[Andor]]|Bari (servant)}}
'''Bari''' is a juggler in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].

==History==
His brother is [[Kin (entertainer)|Kin]].

==Activities==
Valan Luca introduces Bari and various other entertainers to [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]], and [[Juilin Sandar]] when the group joins the show.{{ref/book|5|17}} Bari is also among those that bid the group farewell when they leave.{{ref/book|5|48}}
